Frequently Asked Questions

Are my images uploaded to a server?

No. MediaPilot builds the PDF entirely in your browser. Your images never leave your device.

Will the images lose quality?

No. PNG files are placed into the PDF exactly as they are, without re-compressing. Small images are never stretched beyond their real size.

Is PNG transparency kept?

Yes. PNG files go into the PDF unchanged, so transparent areas stay transparent and show the white page behind them.

Can I convert JPG images too?

Use the JPG to PDF converter — this page only accepts PNG files.
